h1: Paid media for Islamabad: Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ads that track to real leads
intro: 22 Signals runs paid media for Islamabad organisations: Google Search and Performance Max, YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok. We make the creative in-house, build landing pages, and track every lead through to WhatsApp, calls and your CRM, so you can see which spend turns into admissions, bookings, site visits or contracts.

sections.h: Where Islamabad audiences actually see ads
p: Islamabad audiences are spread across platforms. Parents choosing a school scroll Facebook and Instagram in the evening. Patients search Google with a symptom and a sector name. Young buyers watch TikTok and YouTube. Procurement heads, donors and overseas clients of local software firms are on LinkedIn. A plan that puts everything on one platform leaves most of the city unreached.
Any paid media Islamabad organisations commission should start by matching each audience to the channel where it decides, then giving every channel a clear job and a number to hit.

sections.h: Click-to-WhatsApp and the leads you cannot see
p: In Pakistan, much of the response to an ad never reaches a form. People tap a WhatsApp button or call. If those leads are not tracked, the platform reports look poor and the wrong campaigns get cut. We set up click-to-WhatsApp ads, tracked call numbers and CRM entries for every enquiry, then feed qualified leads back to Google and Meta so their systems learn what a good lead looks like.
Of everything we change in paid media, Islamabad clients usually notice this first: the monthly report finally matches what the sales or admissions team sees on the ground.

The Capital Development Authority regularly warns the public about housing schemes that lack approval, and buyers in Islamabad have learned to check. Ads for a project should state what is approved and what is not. Before we run a property campaign, we ask for the approval documents and make sure the ads, landing pages and lead replies all say the same thing. It protects buyers, and it protects your ad accounts from complaints and rejections.
The same care applies in Rawalpindi, where the Rawalpindi Development Authority plays a similar role. If a project's status changes during a campaign, we pause and update the ads as soon as we hear.

Islamabad's ad calendar has its own peaks. Ramadan changes when people are online and what they respond to, Eid brings retail spikes, admissions cycles drive education spend, and June budget weeks shift attention for anyone selling to government-linked buyers. We plan budgets and creative around these dates instead of spreading spend evenly across the year.

We also watch the things that are harder to schedule: a sudden spike in competitor spend before an intake, a platform outage, or news that makes a planned message feel wrong that week. Budgets can be paused or moved quickly when that happens.

We run a managed video editing team for a US client, which is why our ad creative is not an afterthought. When a campaign needs ten new variations of a video by Thursday, the people who make them sit in the same team as the people who run the ads, with the same Signal Lead.

Talk: what you sell, to whom, and what a good lead is worth to you. Plan: channels, budgets, tracking and creative, with launch dates in writing. Build: accounts, tracking, landing pages and the first creative set. Grow: weekly optimisation, monthly reporting and new creative tests, so the account improves rather than drifts. Your Signal Lead reads every report before it reaches you and explains, in plain words, what changed and why.

sections.h: Working with us from Islamabad, and cost factors
p: We run Islamabad campaigns remotely from our head office in London. Weekly check-ins sit in the Islamabad afternoon, for example 11:00 London, which is 16:00 PKT in winter and 15:00 PKT in summer. Who owns each ad account is agreed in writing at the start, you always have access to it, and the platforms bill you directly for ad spend.

We do not publish our management prices for paid media. Islamabad budgets vary widely, and cost depends on the number of platforms, the monthly ad spend, how much creative you need, the number of languages, and how deep the tracking and CRM work goes.

Your ads, landing pages, video and SEO sit with one team, so a search term that converts in Google Ads becomes a page for SEO, and a video that works on TikTok gets cut for YouTube. Related: SEO services in Islamabad, video production and animation, and our global paid media service.

faqs.q: Which ad platform should an Islamabad business start with?
faqs.a: Start where your buyers make the decision. If people already search for what you sell, Google Search usually comes first. For schools, restaurants, retail and property, Meta is usually worth testing early. For B2B and exporters, LinkedIn matters. We usually test two channels first, measure leads properly, then move budget to what works.

faqs.q: Can you run ads in Urdu?
faqs.a: Yes. We write and design ads in Urdu script, Roman Urdu and English, and test which performs for each audience. Many campaigns use English headlines with Urdu or Roman Urdu body text. Landing pages and WhatsApp replies are matched to the ad's language, so the experience does not switch halfway.

You do, directly. The platforms bill your payment method, and our management work is billed separately. Account ownership is agreed in writing at the start, and you always have access to the account history. This keeps your spend transparent.

faqs.q: How do you track leads that come through WhatsApp?
faqs.a: We use click-to-WhatsApp ads and tagged links, so each conversation shows which campaign it came from. Your team marks leads as qualified in the CRM or a shared sheet, and we send that data back to the ad platforms. That lets us judge campaigns on real enquiries rather than clicks.

faqs.q: Do you target Rawalpindi as well as Islamabad?
faqs.a: Yes, when it suits your business. Many Islamabad offers appeal across the twin city, especially schools, clinics, property and retail. We can target both together, split them to compare results, or focus on specific areas if your service only covers part of the region.

faqs.q: Do you make the ad creative?
faqs.a: Yes. Our video, motion graphics and design teams produce the creative for your campaigns, in English and Urdu, and we refresh it regularly because ads tire quickly. If you have brand guidelines or existing footage, we work from those. You approve everything before it runs.
